note: Developer payload overrides. The official distribution archive is verified against the signed catalog and used as-is; these files replace specific archive members during extraction, for boards whose official archives do not boot yet. Loaded only when the manifest is bundled in a developer build (OmarchyDeveloperBuild); large images may be placed out-of-band in ~/Library/Application Support/org.aurorasilicon.installer/J616sOverride/. fedora_only entries apply exclusively to archives carrying root.img (the Fedora layout); NixOS archives always install their own boot and root images.
